load_nlp: load a spaCy Language model with fastText vectors from a .vec file into its vocabulary
decomp: decompose hard questions into pairs of simple questions using beam search over a nearest-neighbor index
dump_pseudoalignments: dump pseudoalignment results to .sh, .sh1, .sh2, and .mh files in a specified directory
get_bert_embedding_path: get the file path for BERT embeddings given a dataset name, split, and optional layer
get_squad_path: get the SQuAD JSON file path for a given train or dev split
